release_notes: Mandatory OPS 4.5.18 app-behaviour release. Task draft saving is now event-driven instead of using fixed autosave seconds: fields save during idle browser work, selections and blur save immediately, leaving or closing flushes the draft, and a dirty drawer only closes after a successful save. Phone, tablet, desktop, split-screen, browser navigation bars and software keyboards now use the real Visual Viewport. Sheets and notices stay above app navigation and inside the visible screen.
